en.label: positive
en.raw:
We thoroughly enjoyed the Westin St. Francis Hotel on Union Square. Conveniently located on busy Union Square, the cable cars are a stone's throw away. You won't be at a loss for things to do, see, and places to dine in this neighborhood.
The hotel was lovely, the staff friendly and helpful, and our room more than adequate. Our bathroom was quite small, but no complaints here. We were treated well as guests and we'll be back when we again visit this happening town.
